packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates once CI passes
Auto-merge devDependency minor bumps once CI passes

One Node major for CI, production and package.json (#140): CI's setup-node node-version, the Dockerfile's node image and engines.node (and @types/node, if the repo adds it) move in one PR, so scripts/check-node-pins.sh stays green. Matched by dep name: the setup-node input's package name is actions/node-versions. config:recommended's group:nodeJs preset sets only a commit message topic, no group name, and skips that input's github-releases datasource.
